headline: Philippine Peso Rebounds Against US Dollar, Lifting Local Stocks
summary: The Philippine peso staged a strong recovery, gaining more than half a peso against the US dollar to return to the P62 level as improved global market sentiment lifted the currency.
why: Currency appreciation in emerging markets often alleviates imported inflation pressures and encourages foreign capital inflows into local equities.

impacts.name: Philippine Peso
impacts.why: Improved global sentiment directly drove the peso's recovery against the dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A shift in global market sentiment drove foreign exchange flows back into the local currency.
